title: P15.10-D: autonomous KPI evidence verification — owner-opt-in delegated verifier grant + receipt-bound canonical progress writes
description: Closes the P15.10-C KPI-UNVERIFIED gap proven on the live op-test: mission COMPLETED + artifact ACCEPTED never produced KPI progress. Adds ONE delegated verifier contract: owner-scoped grant entity objective_kpi_auto_authorization (KVA_) pinning business+objective+kpi+DELIVERABLE_BUNDLE rule+terms_version+expires_at (default OFF, ONE enabled grant per (objective,kpi), revocable/disabling, non-owner create denied). New verifier kind kpi-verifier:<auth_id> inside objective-authority assertOwnerVerifier — never operator:<owner> impersonation; writer identity is the single canonical PAIR_KPI_VERIFIER. ObjectiveKpiVerificationService re-derives every fact in one transaction: workstream child folded DONE + WAL lineage + business.boundMissionForWorkItem + assertCanonicalMissionCompletion + >=1 ACCEPTED artifact bound through its governed_task/mission — filename/path/executor self-report/LLM opinion never count. On satisfaction it writes immutable kpi_verification_receipt (KVR_, digest-bound units/value/terms) and calls the EXISTING recordProgress seam with evidence_key kva:<auth>:<receipt_id> — the P15.1 ledger gives idempotent replay and same-key-different-semantics conflict. P15.5 assertCanonicalObjectiveKpiProgress re-validates the same grant+receipt proof (expires/terms/revoke/terms-drift all fail closed, including retroactively). Operating pass calls kpiVerification.advance once per ACTIVE pass before §6 — TARGET_MET_CANDIDATE unchanged, never auto-ACHIEVED. MC route POST /api/vnext/objectives/:id/kpi-verification owner-scoped grant/revoke/disable/status. Tests: acceptance reproduces the P15.10-C gap (pre UNVERIFIED → partial UNVERIFIED → all verified MET → TARGET_MET_CANDIDATE + owner gate) + 15 adversarial vectors (forged/unaccepted/tampered artifact, cross-mission/business evidence, executor self-report, replay, key-conflict, racing verifiers, revoke/terms-drift/terminal, foreign-kpi claim, out-of-scope KPI type) + grant contract edges. No merge/deploy; driver unchanged OFF.
